_README: ScholarPath bulk question import template — POST /api/admin/questions/bulk-import
Covers all 7 question_type values. Delete the _README and _comment keys before
importing (they are ignored by the parser, but keeping the file clean helps).
VALIDATE BEFORE IMPORTING:
.venv/bin/python backend/scripts/validate_question_json.py yourfile.json
.venv/bin/python backend/scripts/validate_question_json.py yourfile.json --check-db
NOTE: this template PASSES structural validation but FAILS --check-db on purpose.
The sample ids are illustrative: exam 16 already holds Q1-75, and the
marathi_only / image_only / context_image examples use exam 17's sections
(15, 16) because Marathi and Intelligence Test live in Paper II. Replace
exam_id, section_id, topic_id and question_no with your own before importing.
HARD RULES (enforced by importer.py — import fails if broken):
* EXACTLY 4 options per question, option_no exactly [1,2,3,4]
* correct_option must be 1-4 (single answer)
* every option needs text_en, text_mr, or image_url — never all three empty
* section_id and topic_id must exist in the DB and belong to this exam
* question_no must be unique within the exam and fall inside the section range
DB CONSTRAINTS added 2026-08-17 (reject at insert time):
* questions_stem_present_chk       — need stem text or stem image
* questions_image_type_has_image_chk — image_only/text_image need an image
* options_content_present_chk      — every option needs text or an image
SYMBOLS INSTEAD OF IMAGES (preferred where it works):
Unicode symbols in text_en/text_mr render natively — no upload, no CDN,
no broken-image risk, scalable, and language-neutral across all mediums.
Multi-line layouts are preserved (renderers use whitespace-pre-wrap).
GOOD FOR : series, patterns, odd-one-out, mirror/water image, simple
shape classification, matrices, arrows, fractions like ½ ¾ ⅓,
powers x² x³, roots √, angles ∠ABC, set notation ⊂ ∪ ∩.
USE IMAGES FOR: geometry with labelled vertices or shaded regions,
coordinate grids, pictographs, paper-folding, embedded figures,
anything where exact proportions matter.
USEFUL SETS:
partials ◐ ◑ ◒ ◓ ◔ ◕ ◖ ◗
math     ½ ¾ ⅓ ⅔ ¼ ⅕ x² x³ √ ∠ ° ± × ÷ ≠ ≤ ≥ ⊂ ⊃ ∪ ∩ ∈ π ∞
LOOK UP YOUR IDs FIRST:
SELECT s.id AS section_id, s.subject_en, s.question_from, s.question_to,
t.id AS topic_id, t.name_en
FROM sections s JOIN topics t ON t.section_id = s.id
WHERE s.exam_id = <YOUR_EXAM_ID> ORDER BY s.order_index, t.order_index;

contexts._comment: Context 0 — a shared reading passage. Referenced by context_ref: 0.
contexts.content_en: A thirsty crow found a pitcher with very little water at the bottom. He could not reach it. He picked up pebbles one by one and dropped them into the pitcher. Slowly the water rose to the top and the crow drank happily.
contexts.content_mr: एका तहानलेल्या कावळ्याला एक माठ सापडला ज्यात तळाशी थोडेसे पाणी होते. त्याला ते गाठता येत नव्हते. त्याने एक एक करून खडे उचलून माठात टाकले. हळूहळू पाणी वर आले आणि कावळ्याने आनंदाने पाणी प्याले.
contexts.instruction_en: Read the passage and answer questions 3 and 4.
contexts.instruction_mr: उतारा वाचून प्रश्न ३ आणि ४ ची उत्तरे द्या.

contexts._comment: Context 1 — a shared FIGURE for non-verbal reasoning. Referenced by context_ref: 1.
contexts.image_alt_en: A row of four squares with a dot moving one corner clockwise in each step
contexts.image_alt_mr: चार चौरसांची रांग ज्यात प्रत्येक टप्प्यात बिंदू घड्याळाच्या दिशेने एका कोपऱ्याने सरकतो
contexts.instruction_en: Study the figure series and answer question 7.
contexts.instruction_mr: आकृती मालिकेचा अभ्यास करून प्रश्न ७ चे उत्तर द्या.

questions._comment: TYPE 1/7 — 'text': plain text stem, plain text options. The most common type. RULE: text_en required; all 4 options require text_en.
questions.text_en: Which of the following letters make a meaningful word?
questions.text_mr: खालीलपैकी कोणती अक्षरे अर्थपूर्ण शब्द बनवतात?
questions.explanation_en: 'Exercise' is the only correctly spelled word among the options.
questions.explanation_mr: 'Exercise' हा पर्यायांमधील एकमेव योग्य शब्द आहे.
questions.hint_en: Say each option aloud and check the spelling.
questions.hint_mr: प्रत्येक पर्याय मोठ्याने वाचा आणि शुद्धलेखन तपासा.

questions._comment: TYPE 2/7 — 'text_image': text stem PLUS a figure, text options. Use for geometry, pictographs, data charts. RULE: text_en or text_mr required AND question_image_url REQUIRED. IMPORTANT: the image must show ONLY the figure — never the question text or the options, or the student sees them twice.
questions.text_en: Look at the figure. What is the area of the shaded region in square cm?
questions.text_mr: आकृती पहा. छायांकित भागाचे क्षेत्रफळ चौरस सेंमी मध्ये किती आहे?
questions.question_image_alt_en: A rectangle 8 cm by 5 cm with a 3 cm by 2 cm shaded rectangle inside it
questions.question_image_alt_mr: ८ सेंमी बाय ५ सेंमी आयत ज्यात ३ सेंमी बाय २ सेंमी छायांकित आयत आहे
questions.hint_en: Area of a rectangle = length x breadth.

questions._comment: TYPE 3/7 — 'context_text': belongs to a shared passage/poem. RULE: context_ref REQUIRED; text_en or text_mr required; all 4 options require text_en. context_ref: 0 points at contexts[0] above.
questions.text_en: Why could the crow not drink the water at first?
questions.text_mr: कावळ्याला सुरुवातीला पाणी का पिता आले नाही?
questions.explanation_en: The passage says the water was at the bottom and he could not reach it.
questions.explanation_mr: उताऱ्यात म्हटले आहे की पाणी तळाशी होते आणि त्याला ते गाठता येत नव्हते.
questions.hint_en: Re-read the second sentence of the passage.

options.text_en: The water was too low to reach

questions._comment: TYPE 4/7 — 'image_only': the IMAGE IS the question. This is the Intelligence Test 'select the correct image' format. RULE: text_en AND text_mr MUST BE null; needs question_image_url OR context_ref; ALL 4 OPTIONS REQUIRE image_url. Put any wording in question_image_alt_* for accessibility.
questions.question_image_alt_en: Select the mirror image of the given letter F
questions.question_image_alt_mr: दिलेल्या F अक्षराची आरशातील प्रतिमा निवडा
questions.explanation_en: A mirror image flips the figure left-to-right.
questions.explanation_mr: आरशातील प्रतिमा आकृती डावीकडून उजवीकडे उलटवते.
questions.hint_en: Imagine holding the figure up to a mirror on its right side.
questions.hint_mr: आकृती उजव्या बाजूला आरशासमोर धरल्याची कल्पना करा.

options.image_alt_en: Letter F flipped left to right

questions._comment: TYPE 5/7 — 'context_image': image options that share a context figure. RULE: context_ref REQUIRED; ALL 4 OPTIONS REQUIRE image_url. Stem text is optional here (the context carries the instruction). context_ref: 1 points at contexts[1].
questions.explanation_en: The dot advances one corner clockwise at each step, so the next figure has it at the bottom-left.
questions.explanation_mr: बिंदू प्रत्येक टप्प्यात घड्याळाच्या दिशेने एक कोपरा पुढे सरकतो, म्हणून पुढील आकृतीत तो तळाशी डावीकडे असेल.
questions.hint_en: Track only the position of the dot.

options.image_alt_en: Square with dot in the centre

questions._comment: TYPE 6/7 — 'marathi_only': Paper II Section I (Third Language). No English version exists. RULE: text_mr REQUIRED; text_en MUST BE null; ALL 4 OPTIONS REQUIRE text_mr. NOTE: section_id 15 / topic 96 belong to exam 17 — change exam_id to 17 if you import this one.
TYPE 7/7 — 'bilingual': shown EN and MR side by side simultaneously. RULE: BOTH text_en AND text_mr required; all 4 options require text_en (supply text_mr too so both render).
questions.hint_en: The denominators are already the same — just add the numerators.
questions.hint_mr: छेद आधीच समान आहेत — फक्त अंश जोडा.

questions._comment: SPECIAL A — MULTI-SELECT ('select two'). Set is_multi_select true, leave correct_option null, and list correct_options. RULE: correct_options required, values 1-4, no duplicates. question_type stays one of the 7 above.
questions.text_en: Select TWO words from the passage that describe the crow.
questions.text_mr: उताऱ्यातून कावळ्याचे वर्णन करणारे दोन शब्द निवडा.
questions.explanation_en: The passage calls him thirsty, and his use of pebbles shows he is clever.
questions.explanation_mr: उताऱ्यात त्याला तहानलेला म्हटले आहे, आणि खड्यांचा वापर तो हुशार असल्याचे दर्शवतो.
questions.hint_en: One word is stated directly; the other is shown by his actions.
questions.hint_mr: एक शब्द थेट दिला आहे; दुसरा त्याच्या कृतीतून दिसतो.

questions._comment: SPECIAL C — SYMBOL FIGURE, single line. An Intelligence Test series drawn entirely with Unicode. question_type stays 'text' — no image needed, nothing to upload, cannot 404. This is the preferred form for series/pattern/mirror items.
questions.text_en: Which figure comes next in the series?    ◐  ◑  ◒  ?
questions.explanation_en: The shaded half rotates 90 degrees clockwise at each step, so ◓ comes next.
questions.explanation_mr: छायांकित अर्धा भाग प्रत्येक टप्प्यात ९० अंश घड्याळाच्या दिशेने फिरतो, म्हणून ◓ पुढे येतो.
questions.hint_mr: कोणता अर्धा भाग छायांकित आहे ते पहा.

questions._comment: SPECIAL D — SYMBOL FIGURE, MULTI-LINE grid. Newlines (\n) and column alignment are preserved because the renderers use whitespace-pre-wrap (added 2026-08-17). Use real newlines in your editor; JSON escapes them as \n. Align columns with regular spaces.
questions.text_en:
Study the pattern and find the missing figure.

△  ▽  △
▽  △  ▽
△  ▽  ?
questions.text_mr:
नमुन्याचा अभ्यास करून गहाळ आकृती शोधा.

△  ▽  △
▽  △  ▽
△  ▽  ?
questions.explanation_en: Triangles alternate direction along every row and column, so the missing figure is △.
questions.explanation_mr: प्रत्येक ओळ व स्तंभात त्रिकोण दिशा बदलतात, म्हणून गहाळ आकृती △ आहे.
questions.hint_en: Read the third row from left to right.

questions._comment: SPECIAL E — MATH NOTATION in symbols. This is how the mangled fraction questions (e.g. exam 16 Q56) should have been authored. Write fractions inline as ¾ or 3/4 — never as stacked PDF layout, which the extractor flattens into garbage.
questions.hint_en: Find the LCM of the denominators first.

questions.text_en: Which of the following measures is equal to one quintal?
